scope: Typed and scoped report-only optimization regions, recursive views, witnessed logical origins, proposed dependency motion and conservative conflict queries. No backend, automatic hoist or workload speedup.
limitations: Static lexical containment is not observed execution. Runtime invocation subsets never inherit whole-definition effect completeness.
Known data ports are a conservative superset; unclosed consumers/aliases and unattached data-data alias ownership remain explicit gaps.
Origin queries need explicit G4 bindings and scoped producer evidence; archived provisional captures do not acquire equality or origin proofs.
Motion computes known boundary cuts and obligations only; dominance, zero-iteration behavior, state/autograd/readiness and profitability remain separate obligations.
CLI defaults to at most eight selected roots and depth zero; unexpanded/omitted nodes never mean dead work.
Structural overlap, possible shared state and closed-scope effect independence are separate query results, not permission to combine rewrites.
